description: This file provides service functions for managing notifications in a gym management system. It includes listing user notifications, marking notifications as read, creating new notifications, and materializing scheduled reminders.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Notification],int] list_for_user(db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists notifications for a specific user with optional unread filter and pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Notification] mark_read(db: Session, notif_id: int, user_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a notification as read for the specified user.

methods.name: Notification create_notification(db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True)
methods.description: Creates a new notification record, marking it as sent if scheduled time is in the past.

methods.name: int materialize_due_reminders(db: Session, now: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Updates scheduled notifications that are due to be sent by setting their sent_at timestamp.

ctags.name: create_notification
ctags.pattern: /^def create_notification(db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, payload: NotificationCreate, mark_sent_if_past: bool = True)

ctags.name: list_for_user
ctags.pattern: /^def list_for_user(db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, page: int = 1, page_size/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)

ctags.pattern: /^def mark_read(db: Session, notif_id: int, user_id: str) -> Optional[Notification]:$/
